dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for KALX, its official domain, contact page and Music Director address, and for WFMU, its official domain, Send Us Music page and published physical-delivery identifiers. No existing route records were found. Each station was added once as a central physical Music Director route; adjacent general-contact, interview, programme and inquiry paths were not duplicated as submission opportunities.
emailVerificationLevel: KALX officially publishes music@kalx.berkeley.edu for its Music Directors and mail@kalx.berkeley.edu for general contact. The general mailbox explicitly rejects music submissions, and the Music Director mailbox is not authorized for digital music delivery because KALX requires physical professionally pressed CDs or LPs. WFMU exposes no plaintext submission mailbox on the reviewed pages; its JavaScript-dependent Music Department contact form is classified only as a manual inquiry or follow-up boundary. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, message or music submission was sent; no CD, LP, CD-R, cassette, package, stream, download, attachment, biography, press material, metadata, rights declaration, consent, postal form or personal data was supplied; no JavaScript requirement, CAPTCHA, authentication, anti-bot, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
